description: The ORM derives a model's table name from _name (cls._table = cls._name.replace('.', '_')) at 15.0 and 16.0, so a renamed model uses a different table (payment_acquirer to payment_provider); no source file maps data between tables, so raw-SQL references are unmapped
detection_method: raw fetch at pinned revisions; line match
notes: Derivation only. This does not prove that no migration copies data; it shows static source cannot rewrite SQL strings safely. Companion of EV-450.
